SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_status
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT op.payment_type,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM order_payments op
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = op.order_id
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT ca.campaign_name, COUNT(cu.usage_id) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns ca
LEFT JOIN coupons cp ON cp.campaign_id = ca.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = cp.coupon_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id, ca.campaign_name
ORDER BY usage_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
SELECT c.campaign_id, COUNT(cu.usage_id) AS coupon_usage_count
FROM campaigns c
LEFT JOIN coupons cp ON cp.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = cp.coupon_id
GROUP BY c.campaign_id
LIMIT 1000;

FROM inventory i
LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
GROUP BY i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name

       SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,

SELECT r.region_name,
       COUNT(*) AS shipment_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS covered_order_count
FROM shipments s
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
GROUP BY r.region_code, r.region_name
ORDER BY shipment_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ref_level.level_name AS referrer_level, inv_level.level_name AS invitee_level, COUNT(*) AS referral_count, ROUND(SUM(r.reward_amount), 2) AS total_reward
FROM referrals r
LEFT JOIN members rm ON rm.member_id = r.referrer_member_id
LEFT JOIN member_levels ref_level ON ref_level.level_id = rm.level_id
LEFT JOIN members im ON im.member_id = r.invitee_member_id
LEFT JOIN member_levels inv_level ON inv_level.level_id = im.level_id
GROUP BY ref_level.level_id, ref_level.level_name, inv_level.level_id, inv_level.level_name
ORDER BY referral_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT b.brand_name,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN product_brand_map pbm
  ON pbm.product_id = oi.product_id
 AND pbm.is_current = true
JOIN brands b
  ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
GROUP BY b.brand_id, b.brand_name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC
LIMIT 10;
afterSql:
SELECT b.brand_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = oi.product_id AND pbm.is_current = true
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
GROUP BY b.brand_id
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.category_name, st.priority,
       COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count,
       COUNT(tm.message_id) AS message_count
FROM support_tickets st
LEFT JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
LEFT JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id = st.ticket_id
GROUP BY tc.category_name, st.priority
ORDER BY tc.category_name, st.priority
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT w.warehouse_name,
       COALESCE(i.current_stock, 0) AS current_stock,
       COALESCE(m.outbound_90d, 0) AS outbound_90d,
       ROUND(90.0 * COALESCE(i.current_stock, 0) / NULLIF(m.outbound_90d, 0), 1) AS inventory_turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_stock
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
) i ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS outbound_90d
    FROM inventory_movements
    WHERE movement_type = '2'
      AND moved_at >= (SELECT MAX(moved_at) FROM inventory_movements) - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND moved_at <= (SELECT MAX(moved_at) FROM inventory_movements)
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
) m ON m.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_name
LIMIT 100;
afterSql:
-- 各仓库：当前库存、近90天出库量、库存周转天数（时间锚定 movement 最大时间）
WITH anchor AS (
    SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS max_at FROM inventory_movements
),
stock AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS current_stock
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
outbound AS (
    SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS out_qty
    FROM inventory_movements
    WHERE movement_type = '2'
      AND moved_at >= (SELECT max_at FROM anchor) - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND moved_at < (SELECT max_at FROM anchor) + INTERVAL '1 second'
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
)
SELECT w.warehouse_id,
       s.current_stock,
       o.out_qty,
       ROUND(90.0 * s.current_stock / NULLIF(o.out_qty, 0), 1) AS turnover_days
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
ORDER BY w.warehouse_id
LIMIT 1000;
